articles.title: HOW THE NEXT GENERATION OF DRONE, ROBOT AND MACHINE INTELLIGENCE GETS BUILT: A LOOK INSIDE PALETTE 3.0
articles.summary:
Autonomy programs slow down when perception, SLAM, sensor fusion and reasoning are stitched across several boards. In two upcoming live sessions, SiMa.ai's engineers show how to run them together [4] on a single Modalix MLSoC:

* DECEMBER 2, INSIDE PALETTE 3.0 [5]: LLMs, VLMs and vision models side by side, speculative decoding for up to 3.5x tokens per second, and camera tuning that onboards new sensors without recompiling * DECEMBER 8, DRONE AND ROBOT INTELLIGENCE [6]: navigation without GPS, but with MAVLink, PX4 and ArduPilot for drones and ROS 2 for robots, starting on ROSbot XL and drone reference platforms

Both include live Q&A. If you're building physical AI, don't miss them.

articles.title: TRUMP SAYS THE US WILL TAX AMERICAN COMPANIES THAT BUILD DATA CENTERS ABROAD, CITING CHINA'S ACCESS TO RENTED COMPUTE
articles.summary: At a White House press conference, Trump promised a "tremendous tax" on US firms building data centers overseas, specifically naming a proposed Google facility in Finland. Chinese firms rent restricted GPUs from data centers in countries that can legally import them, which is the route Commerce's new licensing rule targets. Operators like Equinix and Digital Realty run facilities abroad partly to cut latency for time-sensitive workloads, so a penalty could complicate global buildout.

articles.title: US INTELLIGENCE REPORTEDLY TRACKED ALICE HUANG'S CONTACTS WITH CHINA'S SPY AGENCY FOR OVER A YEAR, WHILE MEGASPEED SAT INSIDE NVIDIA'S CLOUD PARTNER NETWORK
articles.summary: Alice Huang, a Megaspeed executive, was in touch with a Ministry of State Security officer from Spring 2025 until this fall, overlapping with her relationship with Jensen Huang. Her business partner, Kang Wei, worked with the same agency. Trump was briefed at least twice. Megaspeed, the Singapore operator suspected of diverting restricted Nvidia chips, is now a focus of the investigations, which are continuing.

articles.title: TESLA ROLLS OUT FSD V15 WITH A VISION ENCODER SHARED ACROSS FSD, ROBOTAXI, AND OPTIMUS, CLAIMING 25X BETTER CRITICAL INTERVENTION RATE
articles.summary: The encoder is trained on millions of internet videos and runs on AI4 (HW4) hardware. A new Reality View replaces separate model signals with one end-to-end visualization that uses less compute. v15 also targets known weak spots, including sign reading, potholes, standing water, school zones, and speed cameras, but Tesla published only the 25x multiplier, not the underlying intervention rate. It also loosens driver monitoring at higher-speed profiles.

articles.title: BOOM SUPERSONIC LIGHTS ITS IN-HOUSE ENGINE CORE FOR THE FIRST TIME, A SIX-STAGE COMPRESSOR AND SINGLE-STAGE TURBINE SHARED BY A DATA CENTER TURBINE AND OVERTURE'S ENGINE
articles.summary: The core reached 6,500 rpm with nearly 2,000 sensors on its second light-off attempt, on a Colorado rig that uses a vacuum pump to simulate the bypass duct and a variable nozzle to simulate the low-pressure turbine. The same core underpins the 42 MW Superpower gas turbine for AI data centers and the 40,000 lb Symphony turbofan for the Mach 1.7 Overture, with over 75% commonality. Boom is also building a tooling-free foundry for single-crystal turbine blades.

articles.title: GOOGLE'S QUANTUM PROCESSOR WINS A CONTEXTUALITY GAME 98.3% OF THE TIME AGAINST AN 88.9% CLASSICAL LIMIT, ACROSS TASKS UP TO 105 QUBITS
articles.summary: Contextuality means a qubit's measured value depends on which compatible measurements are made alongside it. New research shows it survives at scale instead of only in few-particle systems. The same game doubles as a sensitive test for subtle hardware errors, which helps validate processors for chemistry and materials science. The qubits also beat constrained classical strategies on tasks spanning up to 105 qubits.

articles.title: A ONE-CRYSTAL-THICK FILM OF MIXED NANOCRYSTALS CAN BOOST OR BLOCK INFRARED LIGHT, AND A NEW MODEL SHOWS HOW TO TUNE IT
articles.summary: Researchers mixed two kinds of tiny crystals, differing in how much tin they contain, into a film just one crystal thick. When infrared light hits it, each crystal's electrons ripple at a slightly different rate, and those ripples overlap in the tiny gaps between neighbors. The film is made in solution, so it avoids expensive etching, and it could be used in thermal camouflage or self-cooling surfaces.

articles.title: SPACEX LENDERS SOUGHT COVENANTS BARRING NVIDIA CHIPS SECURING A $43B DEBT PACKAGE FROM BEING LAUNCHED INTO ORBIT
articles.summary: Lenders fear that if SpaceX defaults, repossessing and reselling GPUs installed in a satellite in orbit would be effectively impossible. SpaceX says the chips are for US data centers it owns and operates, but Musk's orbital compute plans depend on launching silicon aboard Starship. Whether the restriction made it into the final documents, led by Apollo and Goldman Sachs, remains unclear.

articles.title: SILICON PHOTONICS IS THE NEXT STEP FOR AI DATA CENTERS
articles.summary: With construction spending above a $75 billion annual pace and about 3,000 buildings planned or underway, phase-one architecture choices will carry into capacity arriving at the end of the decade. The interconnect between chips sets power per token, and moving data as infrared light through silicon waveguides removes the reach limit. Photonics-SOI, PD-SOI, and RF-SOI platforms each optimize for different metrics and aren't interchangeable.

articles.title: FROSTBITE, A NEW INTERACTION-NET CPU, WITH REPORTEDLY 4.59X THE PERFORMANCE PER WATT OF A SILICON-PROVEN IN-ORDER CORE
articles.summary: Frostbite compiles programs into interaction nets, graphs where node pairs rewrite independently, so parallel work is exposed by the program itself and needs no threads, locks, or out-of-order hardware.

articles.title: SK HYNIX BECOMES KIOXIA'S LARGEST SHAREHOLDER WITH A 14.1% INDIRECT STAKE
articles.summary: The stake comes from converting an investment vehicle's bonds into 129,000 Kioxia shares and buying 1,001 more from Bain Capital, which puts SK Hynix ahead of Toshiba at 10.45%.

articles.title: TSMC REPORTEDLY PAUSES CHINA SHIPMENTS AFTER NEW US RULES PRESUME 16NM AND 14NM LOGIC CHIPS ARE CONTROLLED
articles.summary: TSMC told Chinese designers to halt 16nm-and-below orders without a US license, leaving them on 28nm and 40nm.
